title: compute(a, b) returns None instead of the difference of two finite numeric inputs
description: Bug: src/main.py defines compute(a, b) that currently returns None. Required behavior: compute(a, b) must return the difference of two finite numeric inputs, i.e. a - b. Example: compute(2, 3) must return -1. Must support zero, negative, and fractional values, and reject non-finite/non-numeric inputs. Reproduce the failure first, then fix the implementation in src/main.py, verify with checks/public_check.py, and build with /opt/anaconda3/bin/python -m compileall -q src.
